from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection with its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (known from external documents)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[ProvidedPaper]
